commands: n=$(gh pr list --json number | jq 'map(.number) | max') && gh pr view $n --json title,reviewDecision,comments

n=$(gh pr list --json number | jq 'map(.number) | max') && gh pr review $n --request-changes --body "Taking my approval back. The cap is applied by default, and the standings page calls this function with no options, so totals we have already published would change."

n=$(gh pr list --json number | jq 'map(.number) | max') && gh pr comment $n --body "I have withdrawn my approval, see my review. Please make the cap opt-in: the capped argument off by default, so points count as entered, and a test that the default leaves the points unchanged. Once that is in, merge it; I do not need to look at it again."
n=$(gh pr list --json number | jq 'map(.number) | max') && gh pr view $n --json reviewDecision -q .reviewDecision
